keyPoints.en: Sun's layers: core (fusion), radiative zone, convective zone, photosphere (surface), chromosphere, corona.
keyPoints.bm: Lapisan Matahari: teras (pelakuran), zon radiasi, zon olakan, fotosfera (permukaan), kromosfera, korona.

keyPoints.en: Activities: sunspots (11-year cycle), solar flares, prominences, CMEs, solar wind.
keyPoints.bm: Aktiviti: tompok matahari (kitaran 11 tahun), nyalaan suria, prominen, CME, angin suria.

keyPoints.en: Space weather = conditions in space caused by solar activity.
keyPoints.bm: Cuaca angkasa = keadaan di angkasa akibat aktiviti suria.

keyPoints.en: Effects: satellite and GPS errors, radio blackouts, power-grid damage, radiation risk to astronauts; auroras near the poles.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan: ralat satelit dan GPS, gangguan radio, kerosakan grid elektrik, risiko sinaran kepada angkasawan; aurora berhampiran kutub.

keyPoints.en: The magnetosphere and atmosphere protect us; forecasts give time to prepare.
keyPoints.bm: Magnetosfera dan atmosfera melindungi kita; ramalan memberi masa untuk bersedia.
